title: Paphos quarry-sector two-hour stoppage planned for 24 January 2023
exclusion_reason: The planned two-hour work stoppage was called off before it was reported to occur after the agriculture minister intervened and a meeting was scheduled for 25 January. This is a cancelled plan, not a physical event. The 31 January protest is a separate candidate.

plan_status.summary: Cyprus Mail reports the strike was announced Monday and called off on 24 January after ministerial intervention; a 25 January meeting was scheduled.

relationship.summary: The same quarry-permit issue recurs on 31 January, but action dates and occurrence status are preserved separately.
